**How do I save my project and come back later**
1. Click "Save / Open" in the top toolbar (SPB Projects). It saves the project zones and layer state plus the source-paint path in one project file. Keep that source available at the saved path to reopen it.
2. To reopen, click "Save / Open" again and load it.
Exact controls: Save / Open (Pro > top toolbar (tool row)); SAVE SHOKK (Pro > left column > ZONES > More (three-dot) menu).

limitations: Reviewed the immutable isolated W113 controller snapshot; no live source changes. The candidate provides accurate project/source pixel distinctions, target-bound suggestion receipt language, and the current Solid-versus-Source guidance.

A source-less operation fixture (empty zones/layers; transaction uncommitted) confirmed Save/Open setup guidance on offlineAsk/offlineAskCore and no ask/paint queue through send. This is controller-level guidance, not a native UI or save/open test.

The VM exercises candidate offlineAsk/offlineAskCore/send with controlled operation and queue adapters. It stubs offlineLookAsk, so the polite roof-solid-blue queue outcome cannot be proven here; polite hood-chrome and roof-matte-black controls queue successfully. No app save/open/paint application was performed.

Receipt questions ran without seeded production receipt history; verification covers honest “no current receipt” messaging, not operation IDs or actual recent-history lookup. The test finish adapter records sends but does not emulate the complete UI renderer. Native renderer, browser, providers, and external services were not used.
